title: Halloween's origins linked to the fall Taurid meteor shower

tellings.quote: talk about the connection between the ancient origins of our uh Halloween celebration and the Torid meteor shower.

plain: Halloween has ancient roots in the Taurid meteor shower, a shower of shooting stars that comes every autumn, according to a researcher named Randall Carlson. He raises the link with Michels without naming a source, and it would mean the holiday preserves an old memory of danger from the sky.
